# BuildCalc — Construction & Building Calculator Hub
> Practical calculators for real-world building projects, construction, remodeling, and landscaping.

Website: https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app

## Overview
BuildCalc is a fast, client-side engineering utility platform providing mathematical formulas, material estimates, and construction cost calculators.

## Trade Categories
- [Construction](https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app/categories/construction): House building, foundations, framing, materials, and project estimates.
- [Concrete](https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app/categories/concrete): Volume, slabs, mix design, footings, and concrete materials.
- [Home Improvement](https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app/categories/home-improvement): Wall paneling, garages, flooring, decks, and renovation calculations.
- [Landscaping](https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app/categories/landscaping): Mulch, patios, stone walls, gravel, soil, and outdoor projects.
- [Project Cost](https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app/categories/project-cost): Construction costs, material costs, labor estimates, and renovation budgets.

## Available Calculators

### Project Cost
- [House Construction Cost Calculator](https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app/calculators/house-construction-cost-calculator): Estimate total residential construction cost based on square footage, finish quality tier, foundation, basement, and garage stalls.
- [Construction Cost Per Square Foot Calculator](https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app/calculators/construction-cost-per-square-foot-calculator): Compute unit square-foot rates and overall budgets for new builds, additions, full remodels, and workshops.

### Concrete & Masonry
- [Concrete Calculator](https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app/calculators/concrete-calculator): Calculate concrete volume in cubic yards, cubic feet, and cubic meters for slabs, curbs, and round column Sonotubes. Includes 40/50/60/80 lb bag counts.
- [Concrete Slab Material Calculator](https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app/calculators/concrete-slab-calculator): Estimate ready-mix volume, crushed gravel base tonnage, rebar grid sticks (12", 18", 24" spacing), and vapor barrier rolls.
- [Concrete Mix Design Calculator](https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app/calculators/concrete-mix-design-calculator): Proportions of Portland cement bags (94 lb), concrete sand, gravel, and water for target compressive strengths (2000, 2500, 3000, 3500, 4000 PSI).
- [Deck Footing Size Calculator](https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app/calculators/deck-footing-size-calculator): Calculate deck pier diameter, tributary loads, frost depth excavation, and concrete volume based on soil bearing capacity.
- [Basement Materials Calculator](https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app/calculators/basement-materials-calculator): Estimate 8x8x16 CMU blocks, poured concrete volume, Type S mortar bags, rebar footage, and waterproofing membrane for foundation walls.

### Hardscape & Landscaping
- [Patio Slope Calculator](https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app/calculators/patio-slope-calculator): Calculate drainage pitch (1/4" per foot), vertical elevation drop, crushed base gravel tonnage, and bedding sand.
- [Stone Wall Calculator](https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app/calculators/stone-wall-calculator): Calculate tons of natural stone (fieldstone, flagstone, ashlar, river rock), wall volume, drainage gravel backfill, and mortar.
- [Pine Straw Mulch Calculator](https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app/calculators/pine-straw-mulch-calculator): Calculate square bales and large round rolls needed for landscape beds at 2" to 4" depth, plus annual refresh estimates.

### Home Improvement & Renovation
- [Wall Paneling Calculator](https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app/calculators/wall-paneling-calculator): Calculate 4x8/4x10 sheets, 6" and 8" shiplap boards, door and window opening deductions, and panel construction adhesive.
- [Garage Door Cable Length Calculator](https://buildcalc-tan.vercel.app/calculators/garage-door-cable-length-calculator): Replacement cable cut lengths for standard torsion drums, high-lift rise, vertical lift, and extension springs with safety dead wraps.
